name: Doctor of Medicine First Peoples Scholarship
summary: $20,000 over the degree for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students starting Griffith's Doctor of Medicine.
key: $20,000 for the duration of the degree.
who: Commencing the Doctor of Medicine as a First Peoples candidate.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Include a personal statement and proof of Aboriginality or a community letter of support.
catches: Listed as coming soon for 2027; the 2026 round closed 13 April 2026.
